name: Indigo
source:
1400 years ago: first murderer demons get spotted.
700 years ago: western technology start to get used for rebellion.
500 years ago: murderer demons learn to acquire human appearance in Transylvania.
18 years ago: a huge massacre takes part in Japan.
10 years ago: a murderer demon awakens at the age of six in Japan.
Nowadays: 
Sakurano Mana gets worried by the murderous desire overflowing her body.
Onose Kiri is troubled about her past when she lost one hand and one leg.
Kaiho Kazuki investigates murderer demon he killed at the age of six. Then Kazuki meets these girls and other strong people in this town full of death scent.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/02/indigo-review.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1400年前：人们首次发现“杀人鬼”。
700年前：西方技术开始被用于叛乱。
500年前：特兰西瓦尼亚的杀人鬼学会化为人形。
18年前：日本发生一场大屠杀。
10年前：一名杀人鬼在日本于六岁时觉醒。
现在：
桜野真菜为体内不断涌出的杀戮冲动深感不安。
小野濑雾因往事饱受折磨，那场变故令她失去一手一足。
海保一树则在调查自己六岁时杀死的杀人鬼。
随后，一树在这座弥漫死亡气息的小镇遇见了她们，以及其他身怀强大力量的人。

[根据 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2021/02/indigo-review.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]
